units.source_text: 當時，那家咖啡酒吧的費用全部是常子一個人買單，連這種俗事也開始讓我耿耿於懷，

en.t: At the time, all the expenses at that cafe bar were paid by Tsuneko alone, and even that vulgar matter began to weigh on my mind,

units.source_text: 我覺得常子最終跟房東的女兒、高等女子師範大學的那個女人沒啥兩樣，都是脅迫我的女人，

en.t: I felt that in the end Tsuneko was no different from the landlady's daughter or that woman from the Women's Higher Normal School; they were all women who coerced me,

units.source_text: 即使遠離她們，還是對她們充滿恐懼，

en.t: and even when I was far away from them, I remained full of fear toward them,

units.source_text: 而且我覺得，再次遇到自己睡過的女人時，

en.t: and I thought that whenever I met again a woman I had slept with,

units.source_text: 她們可能會突然怒火噴發，因而非常恐懼再次與她們重逢。

en.t: she might suddenly erupt in anger, and for that reason I was terribly afraid of seeing such women again.

units.source_text: 基於這種性質，我對銀座採取了敬而遠之的態度。

en.t: Because of this disposition, I kept Ginza at a respectful distance.
